title: Passport holder
slide_intent: Connect a brand object to a relevant activity because physical context can make an abstract promise tangible.
strategic_value: A passport holder with Duo in a window can connect Duolingo’s learning identity with travel.
demonstration: A green passport holder contains travel documents and carries a window-shaped Duo illustration above a white wordmark.
practical_value: Compare the role of an illustration and signature on a small travel accessory.

content_islands.name: Travel documents
content_islands.spec: Allow the passport and papers to project above the holder.

content_islands.name: Holder graphics
content_islands.spec: Center the window-framed Duo above the white wordmark on the green cover.

reference_purposes.Application: The accessory visualization applies character imagery and signature to a passport holder.
